data.description_en:
Product type: Ready-to-eat refrigerated salad ❄️
Net weight: 300g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

DELIVERY NOTE (OUTSIDE GUANGZHOU) 📦

Meals shipped outside Guangzhou are sealed and typically arrive within 24 hours of leaving our facility. To maintain freshness, we use foam boxes, insulated bags, and ice packs to control temperature. Once received, store immediately in the refrigerator and check the best-before date. These are fresh-made, short shelf-life products.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This is our most-loved salad — and for good reason.

Cooked Bolivian red and white quinoa, finely chopped crisp vegetables, and perfectly tender chickpeas come together in a bowl that actually satisfies.

Then it gets finished with a bright basil-lemon vinaigrette — lightly sweet, gently acidic, and fresh with green herbal notes.

The result? Clean, vibrant, and seriously craveable.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

High in fiber from diverse vegetables.

Complete plant protein from quinoa and chickpeas.

Balanced carbohydrates for steady energy.

Built to keep you full — not hungry an hour later.

SALAD INGREDIENTS 🌱

Cooked mixed quinoa (red & white), cucumber, red bell pepper, cilantro, red cabbage, chickpeas, apple, spices

DRESSING INGREDIENTS 🫒

Olive oil, basil, lemon zest, apple cider vinegar, lemon juice, agave syrup, spices

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: None declared
May contain traces of: Gluten, Soy, Tree nuts

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

Keep refrigerated.
Mix dressing into salad before eating.
Best enjoyed chilled.

NUTRITION — SALAD 🧮

Calories 207kcal
Fat 4g
Carbohydrates 37.9g
Protein 8.5g

NUTRITION — DRESSING 🧮

Calories 165kcal
Fat 13.8g
Carbohydrates 11.5g
Protein 0.5g

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Store at 0–4°C at all times.
Shelf life: See packaging.

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based full-meal salad 🌿
High-fiber, complete-protein bowl
Designed to satisfy without heaviness
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食冷藏沙拉 ❄️
净含量：300g ⚖️
产地：中国广州 🌍

配送说明（广州以外地区）📦

寄往广州以外地区的餐食经过密封包装，通常在离开我们设施后 24 小时内送达。 为确保新鲜度，我们使用泡沫箱、保温袋及冰袋进行温控配送。 收到后请立即冷藏，并留意包装标示的保质日期。 本产品为短保质期食品。

产品描述 🧾

人气最高的一款沙拉。

煮熟的玻利维亚红白藜麦，搭配切成米粒大小的清爽蔬菜与软度适中的鹰嘴豆，层次丰富却不厚重。

最后淋上酸甜平衡、带青草罗勒与柠檬香气的油醋汁。

清爽、明亮、真实好吃。

为什么人们会选它 🌾

丰富蔬菜纤维，结构扎实。

藜麦与鹰嘴豆提供完整植物蛋白。

优质碳水带来稳定能量。

是一份真正能当一餐、不容易饿的饱腹沙拉。

沙拉配料 🌱

熟红白混合藜麦、黄瓜、红甜椒、香菜、红甘蓝、鹰嘴豆、苹果、香料

酱汁配料 🫒

橄榄油、罗勒、柠檬皮、苹果醋、柠檬汁、龙舌兰蜜、香料

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：未声明常见致敏原
可能含有微量：麸质、大豆、坚果

食用方式 🍽️

冷藏保存。
食用前将酱汁拌匀。
建议冷食。

营养信息 — 沙拉 🧮

热量 207kcal
脂肪 4g
碳水化合物 37.9g
蛋白质 8.5g

营养信息 — 酱汁 🧮

热量 165kcal
脂肪 13.8g
碳水化合物 11.5g
蛋白质 0.5g

贮存与保质期 ❄️

全程 0–4°C 冷藏保存。
保质期：见包装标示。

食用提示 📌

植物性正餐沙拉 🌿
高纤维，完整蛋白结构
清爽却有分量
